book.name: Heꞌitaꞌita
book.title: HEꞌITAꞌITA Yoni ꞌina heꞌitaꞌita Yesu ꞌoinega

content: MeIsileli debadiya Yehoba ꞌana ꞌilaꞌilala siꞌabi hepaꞌineya

Ginaula bewa mulina aneloseyao ꞌehata yaꞌitediya sitotoholo baleꞌu tupwanao ꞌadi baibaiwa ꞌehata ꞌoidiya. Aneloseyedi yaumai ꞌadi baibaiwa ꞌehata siꞌabi yahidiya ma ꞌabehega geyaꞌabwa baleꞌuwa, nuwana holai, nuwana ꞌaiwe ꞌoidiya sitowatowa,

weyahina Yehoba ꞌina tagwala ma ꞌabehega yaumaiyedi baleꞌu ta hola sisuba hegaladi. Coinega anelose wete ꞌaigeda yaꞌiteya sinala ꞌina ꞌebe saehaneyega ꞌinaonaoma, ma maꞌina ꞌebe lagu ꞌilaꞌilala, gide basilili, ma ꞌabehega Yehoba miyamiya hatayaina ꞌana ꞌilaꞌilalaina ꞌilagu tomota debadiya. Aneloseina ꞌibwau anelose ꞌehataedi ꞌoidiya,
ꞌigwaeya, “Geyaꞌabwa baleꞌu bo hola bo ꞌaiwe wasubasuba hegaladi ee ꞌana siga ꞌida Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao ꞌadi ꞌilaꞌilala ꞌalagu debadiya.”
Coinega ꞌilaꞌilalaina silaguya tupwana meIsileli debadiya, ma muliyega meIsileliyedi ꞌadi baibaiwa yahesagohediya, beno 144 tausani mabwaiyana, boda Isileliyedi ꞌoidiyega.
Susu Yuda ꞌoidiyega ꞌilaꞌilalaina tomota tuwelo tausani debadiya silaguya, ma Lubeni tuwelo tausani, ma Gada tuwelo tausani,
wete Aseli tuwelo tausani, ma Napitalai tuwelo tausani, ma Manasa tuwelo tausani,
wete Simioni tuwelo tausani, ma Libai tuwelo tausani, ma Isaka tuwelo tausani,
wete Sebuloni tuwelo tausani, ma Yosepa tuwelo tausani, ma wete Beniyamina tuwelo tausani.

Muliyetega yaꞌeꞌebubuna ta boda madou hedade yaꞌitediya, geya ꞌaihasila. Bodaedi ꞌebeloina ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega, ta susu ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega, ta boda ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega, ta ꞌenana ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega, mabwaiyadi wagahata wasawasa matana, ma wete Lami matana sitotoholo, ta ꞌadi ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌedi, ma sadasada nabaina siꞌabiꞌabi yahidi,
ta ꞌenadi madounega sibwaubwau sigwaeya, “Cada lema ꞌida Yehoba ꞌoinega, tauna wagahata wasawasa ꞌoina ꞌimiyatoiya, ma wete lamiina ꞌoinega.”
Ma aneloseyedi wagahata wasawasaina ma wete babadaowedi ma hebaiyedi ꞌehata sitoholo sakowasiyediya, ma mabwaiyadi sibeꞌu talutalubuꞌiya, ta Yehoba ꞌoina siꞌeꞌetuluha,
sigwaegwae, “Moisa, ꞌida Yehoba ꞌoina tahepwatu ma taꞌahwa wasawasae ma sanapu ta loyauwedo ta heꞌasisi ta waiwai simiya hataya ꞌoina.”
Eeta babadaowedi ꞌoidiyega ꞌaigeda ꞌihesilala ꞌoiguwa, ꞌigwaeya, “Taiyawedi bewa maꞌadi ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌedi? Ma toꞌehega sinaoma?”

Ma ꞌoina yagwaeya, “Bada ꞌowa ꞌusanasanapudi. Taugu geya.” Ta ꞌihegwaegauwa, ꞌigwae, “Bewa bodaedi baleꞌu ꞌana muyamuyao ꞌoidiyega situpwa, ma ꞌadi ꞌaleꞌowedi Lamiina bweyahinega ꞌideulidiya ta siwaꞌeꞌeya.

Beno huhuna ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌina wagahata wasawasa matana simiyamiya, ma sabwelo ma nihuwana ꞌoidiya ꞌina paihowao sipaipaihowadi ꞌina Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona. Yehobaina ꞌina wagahata wasawasaina ꞌimiyatoiya ꞌoina, tauna nata ꞌiꞌitayahidi,
ma geyaꞌabwa wete sigomagomale nuwana taniꞌodi ꞌiyahayahala, ma geyaꞌabwa wete hala nuwana toꞌaha hulahulaina ꞌoinega ꞌihulahulaidi.
Weyahina Lamiina, tauna wagahata wasawasa ꞌalona ꞌimiyamiya, tauna ꞌadi toꞌitayahina, ma ꞌoinega ꞌihanugetedi weꞌaha bwebweꞌadi ꞌoidiya, yawasidi weyahina, ma Yehoba tauna mataneudi ꞌiloꞌiꞌilidi.”
